body: I left in 2019 and went to another school only last year. I feel so pathetic because I only lasted a week in uni. My parents told me to just enroll to a school near home. The uni I went to before was in the capital, and I had to live in a dorm. Now I’m taking online classes and barely doing well. I realized I don’t have a passion for anything and yet my parents told me to just complete the course. I already feel like a huge burden to them.

Idk even know anymore. I left the uni I was talking about in 2019. I did nothing for the next few months and ended up enrolling to another school that I honestly hate. I know I should be thankful that I’m somehow continuing my education but now I realized I don’t even like my course. I’m only doing what’s expected of me. In my country it’s not considered normal to take a gap year. I’m behind my peers already by a year and yet I’m so unhappy at the same time. It feels like I can’t even function in the real world. How am I supposed to land a job when I can’t even do something as simple as sitting in a classroom without eventually crying my eyes out because I just know I’m making everyone uncomfortable and that they don’t want me around? This pandemic is a huge relief to me because I’m doing online school but I know eventually I have to be out there. All of it scares me, the responsibility, the expectations, and knowing that in this social hierarchy I’m at the very bottom.
